recording_year.Description: Year of the recording. The source sets NWB session_start_time to 1 January of the recording year 'to avoid disclosure of protected health information (PHI)'; only the year is therefore meaningful and no acq_time is given. Caveat: all 16 files of DANDI 000940 state 2018, whereas DANDI 000673 (NEMAR nm000368) dates the Sternberg sessions of 7 of the 9 shared patients to 2019 or 2020 (P61CS, P62CS, P64CS, TWH109, TWH110, TWH113: 2019; P65CS: 2020); the value is kept as released but may not be the true recording year for every participant.

source_file.Description: Original NWB file (DANDI asset path) from which the recording was converted; byte-identical copy under sourcedata/dandi-000940/.

source_sha256.Description: SHA-256 of the source NWB file, equal to the DANDI asset digest dandi:sha2-256.

source_lfp_starting_time_s.Description: starting_time of acquisition/LFPs in the NWB session clock; event onsets are source times minus this value.

float32_max_abs_error_uV.Description: Largest absolute difference between the float32 values stored in the BrainVision file and the float64 source values (microvolts), i.e. the only change introduced by this conversion (float32 rounding).
